source.quote: Cen.Grand's own English page for the 9i-90SA Pro DAC / headphone amplifier / pre-amp, read 2026-11-27 with curl. USB: « XMOS second generation XU208 + FPGA digital processing module , isolation technology is used to isolate noise from the computer. Support for NativeDSD512 and PCM384 input. » Converter and S/PDIF: « CT5302 + ESS 9038Pro DAC chip. The SPDIF receiver has three interfaces: coaxial, optical, and AES, support PCM 24bit/192KHz and DOP (DSD64) inputs. » « The 9i-90SA Pro works in 2 channel parallel mode. » Summary rows: « Maximum audio support specifications: Spdif input ----- PCM192 » and « USB input ----- DSD512 PCM384 ». Volume: « The volume control chip is PGA2311 which controlled by MCU and the volume range is -70db~0db. »

facts.chip: One ESS ES9038PRO run « in 2 channel parallel mode »; CT5302 S/PDIF receiver; XMOS XU208 plus an FPGA module on USB.

_the_SPDIF_sentence_names_all_three_sock: « The SPDIF receiver has three interfaces: coaxial, optical, and AES, support PCM 24bit/192KHz and DOP (DSD64) inputs. » Optical is named in the sentence that carries the ceiling, so its 192 kHz / 24 bit is the maker's figure, not a device ceiling copied down.
_no_USB_word_length: USB is rated « NativeDSD512 and PCM384 » with no bit depth, so inputs.usb.bits is absent; whether USB also takes DoP is not stated either.
_a_DAC_that_is_also_a_headphone_amp: The maker titles it « DAC/headphone Amp/Pre Amp » and describes it as « a DAC which with coaxial, optical, AES and other digital input interfaces ». The analogue RCA/XLR inputs feed the pre-amp and are not recorded.
